abstract_fields.value: Jack in the Box (franchised quick-service restaurant)
abstract_fields.note: Public brand only. The franchisee legal entity is withheld and must stay in the private workspace.
If genuinely NNN, the landlord's operating-cost exposure is limited to structural and roof items the lease assigns back. Verify which items are carved out.

An eight-year window is too wide to price. The exact expiration date and any options determine whether the asset has 3 or 9 years of contract rent left. This is the highest-value missing input in the whole project (G-04).
Options are frequently 5 x 5 years. Their existence changes the hold case more than any market forecast.
Unilateral option vs. mutual agreement vs. landlord consent with conditions.
Kept out of this repository by design. The calculator takes it as a local input that never leaves the reader's browser.
A radius restriction can block re-leasing to a competing QSR after expiry, which materially caps the post-2030 rent.
Guarantor identity is private. Only the existence and strength of the guaranty matter to underwriting.
Decisive for the seismic and fire tail cases: who bears rebuild cost, and whether the tenant can terminate on casualty.
An estoppel is normally required by a buyer at closing; its absence is a schedule risk on any sale.

notice_calendar.action: Missing the window can forfeit the option entirely. This is the only calendar item that can permanently destroy value, so it must be pinned first.
Set two internal reminders at 180 and 90 days before this date.
A tenant notice starts the clock on downtime and re-leasing cost.
The 2030-2035 window in the brief is the only date evidence available.

Los Angeles County assessor publishes the annual cycle. Delinquency triggers a 10% penalty plus a $10 cost, then a further 1.5% per month after 2027-04-10. Confirm exact amounts on the county tax collector bill.

This deadline is four days after the 2026-11-26 cut-off of this report. If the assessed value exceeds market value, this is a live, dated opportunity to cut the property tax bill. It is the one action item on the calendar that is both verified and imminent.
Unknown renewal date and unknown premium change. Both are required before any sell-versus-hold comparison can be called reliable.
Applies only if a like-kind exchange is elected. Cannot be extended except in a presidentially declared disaster.

notice_calendar.rule: 180 calendar days from closing, or the return due date, whichever is earlier
notice_calendar.action: Selling with the intention to exchange but failing the 180-day rule converts a deferred gain into a fully taxable one.

notice_calendar.rule: 1% base property tax + voter-approved debt; max 2% annual inflation cap until change of ownership or new construction
notice_calendar.action: A long-held parcel carries a below-market Prop 13 tax shield that disappears for a buyer on sale (and resets on any major rebuild). Check whether lease passes 100% of reassessment to tenant on transfer.

reconciliation.reason: Both sides of the reconciliation are incomplete. The lease side has no exact dates (NC-01 to NC-04 all null), and the calendar side is missing the insurance renewal (NC-08). A reconciliation over an eight-year date window would be false precision.
what_would_close_it: Executed lease and all amendments, read by a qualified abstractor, producing exact dates for NC-01 to NC-04.
Insurance binder with renewal date and premium history.
Any estoppel certificate already issued to a lender or prior buyer.
Any City of Los Angeles retrofit order or notice affecting the building.
reconciliation.hard_stop: No sale or renewal commitment should be signed until NC-01 and NC-02 are pinned to exact dates. An option missed is unrecoverable; everything else on this page is recoverable.
